items_flat.title_en: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 5.5, first model in the Claude 5.5 family
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Opus 5.5，Claude 5.5 系列首發
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic and @claudeai announced Claude Opus 5.5 as available today, calling it the first model in a new Claude 5.5 family. Official copy says it performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 for most tasks and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5. The newsroom listed the item under Announcements dated Sep 22, 2026; a dedicated long-form blog URL was not yet resolvable at digest time.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 與 @claudeai 宣布 Claude Opus 5.5 即日起可用，並定位為新 Claude 5.5 系列的第一個模型。官方說法是多數任務達到 Claude Fable 5.1 水準，運行成本較 Opus 5 低約 40%。官網新聞室以 2026-09-22 公告列出此項；截稿時完整長文網址尚無法解析。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a mid-cycle price/performance squeeze on Anthropic’s own daily-driver tier, not a new frontier peak: the claim is Fable-class utility at a cheaper Opus bill. What remains unverified in public docs is pricing tables, API model IDs, eval numbers, and whether 5.5 is a new base or a post-train of Opus 5.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是自家日常主力檔的中期性價比下壓，不是新的能力天花板：賣點是接近 Fable 的實用性、更低的 Opus 帳單。公開文件尚未核實價目、API 型號 ID、評測數字，以及 5.5 是新基底還是 Opus 5 的後訓練。
items_flat.quote: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in our new Claude 5.5 family. It performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 for most tasks, and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.
items_flat.quote_zh: 推出 Claude Opus 5.5，我們新 Claude 5.5 系列的第一個模型。多數任務表現達到 Claude Fable 5.1 水準，運行成本較 Opus 5 低 40%。

brief_en: Anthropic opened Taipei’s 23 Sep with Claude Opus 5.5, first of a 5.5 family: Fable 5.1-class work at 40% lower run cost than Opus 5. No other tracked lab posted a verified new ship in the window. Meta Connect’s Zuck keynote is still ahead (16:00 PT).
brief_zh: 台北時間 9/23 開盤，Anthropic 推出 Claude Opus 5.5（5.5 系列首發）：多數工作接近 Fable 5.1，運行成本較 Opus 5 低約 40%。窗口內無其他大廠可核實新品。Meta Connect 祖克柏主題演講尚在稍晚（太平洋 16:00）。
